title: Best Game Guide and Gameplay Recording Creators (2026)
description: How to hire someone for gameplay recordings, walkthroughs or written game guides: quality, rights, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Game recording and guide creators produce gameplay footage, walkthroughs, tutorials, tips videos and written guides for players, websites and game developers. Good guides are accurate, easy to follow and up to date with the latest version of the game. Projects go wrong when footage quality is poor, guides are outdated, or game publisher rules on video use are ignored. This guide helps you get recordings and guides players find useful.
